snapshot.text: Solidarity-based social insurance system delivering good care, but with long waiting times, high private costs and a growing two-tier risk. Many specialists now work outside public insurance, and budget pressure is driving a federal-state reform push.

minister.name: Korinna Schumann
minister.role: Health Minister (Federal Ministry of Social Affairs, Health, Care and Consumer Protection)

priorities.title: Health Reform Fund for primary care
priorities.text: A roughly 500 million euro annual fund over five years, financed by pensioner health insurance levies, aims to expand primary care units, prevention and digital services.

priorities.title: Federal-state health reform partnership
priorities.text: Federal government, provinces and municipalities are negotiating a reorganisation of health responsibilities and financing, with a political agreement targeted for June 2026.

priorities.title: Nationwide uniform patient steering system
priorities.text: A uniform national patient steering system is planned from 2027, intended to shorten waiting times and speed up diagnoses and surgery appointments.
